title: Pesto Puff Pastry Pinwheel
description: Pesto and ricotta cheese are spread over puff pastry which is cut and twisted into an appetizing pinwheel that begs to be pulled apart.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons all-purpose flour, or as needed

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a baking tray with parchment paper and dust lightly with flour.
Lay puff pastry on a flat work surface; cut a 12-inch circle from each sheet. Transfer 1 circle to the prepared baking sheet.
Spread ricotta evenly over the pastry circle. Top with an even layer of pesto. Lay the second pastry circle on top. Set a small glass upside down in the middle of the circle.

Cut the circle, away from the glass, into 4 equal quarters. Cut each quarter in half, then each eighth in half, to make 16 equal strips. Remove glass. Twist strips twice, two at a time, in the opposite direction. Pinch ends together. Repeat with remaining strips to make a pinwheel shape.
Bake in the preheated oven until pastry is browned, 25 to 30 minutes.

video.description: As fun to make as it is to eat, this pesto and ricotta-filled puff pastry delivers big on flavor while being an easy target for hungry guests with its tempting pinwheel shape. Learn the simple method for rolling out puff pastry, spreading with layers of ricotta and pesto, then cutting and twisting to create the distinctive shape. Bake until golden then watch your happy crowd pull it apart!
